exposure: Women who underwent caesarean hysterectomy without IR
Women who underwent caesarean hysterectomy for histologically confirmed PAS with a staged surgical and IR approach
Combined surgical and interventional radiology approach to managing placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
combined surgical and interventional radiology (IR) approach to managing PAS
outcome: Volume of packed red cells transfused
cohort: Forty-six women with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) in a tertiary maternity centre between January 2001 and July 2020
finding: A staged procedure combining surgery and interventional radiology (IR) for PAS results in a considerable reduction in blood loss, need for transfusion, and units of packed red cells transfused compared with surgery alone.
